notes.title: Small bug fix for Index users
notes.notes: Wolf and Wood pushed out a new update affecting a small number of Index users whereby the world would disappear after finding the crucifix and tape recordings for the first time.   If you still encounter this issue after the update, please reach out to us at [url=https://www.exorcistlegion.com/bugs]Bug Report[/url]

notes.title: Controller Bug Fixes & WMR Headset Support
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35897653/6c6224a28765f54803d69b903dc56686e8d7f4fc.png[/img]

Hello Exorcists!  We just rolled out an update for the Deluxe Edition yesterday. Please make sure you download this patch the next time you log in.

[b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] An issue whereby some controllers would stop working after picking up the Holy Water in Episode 1 "First Rites" has been fixed.
[*] For those who prefer snap turn over free turning, swipe rotation on the Vive wands has been fixed.
[*] We now fully support WMR headsets and controller support has been added!
[/list]

[i]in nomine Patris et Filii et Spiritus Sancti...[/i]
